description: Snowflake Scripting grammar-gap coverage: untyped DECLARE items with inferred types, stray empty statements (lone ;) as no-ops in a procedure body, CALL result column named after the procedure, and OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*) with EXCLUDE of one or several columns. Converted 1:1 from scripting/ProceduralSqlGapTest (now retired).

steps.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE p_untyped()
    RETURNS VARCHAR
    LANGUAGE SQL
AS
$$
DECLARE
    cid := 'abc-123';
    n := 7;
BEGIN
    RETURN :cid || '/' || :n;
END
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE loader_demo_test()
    RETURNS OBJECT
    LANGUAGE SQL
AS
$$
BEGIN
    RETURN OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('result', 'passed');
END
$$
CREATE TABLE t_star (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, src INTEGER)
SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*) AS o FROM t_star
CREATE TABLE t_excl (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, src INTEGER)
SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(* EXCLUDE src) AS o FROM t_excl
CREATE TABLE t_excl2 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, src INTEGER)
SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(* EXCLUDE (a, b)) AS o FROM t_excl2
